artworks.title: Idmon and Mopsus Guided by Apollo
artworks.description: Met plate from the Medici Argonaut pageant: Apollo steers a ship carrying Idmon and the Argonaut seer Mopsus (Ampycus’ son — not the Colophonian). Festival print keeps Idmon named among the knowing prophets of the Argo.

popCulture.title: Argonautica (death of Idmon)
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius’ seer — Apollo’s son (or Abas’) — reads his own death in the birds, sails anyway, and is gored by a boar among the Mariandyni. The Argonaut who foresaw the end and went.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca (Argonauts)
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus lists Idmon among the Argonauts and records the boar that killed the knowing seer — the handbook version of Apollonius’ Mariandynian death.
